Minutes of City Council
MINUTES OF A REGULAR MEETING OF
THE CITY COUNCILOF THE CITY OF CALABASAS,
CALIFORNIA, HELD WEDNESDAY, OCTOBER 13, 2010
OPENING MATTERS
Call to Order/Roll Call of Councilmembers
Pledge of Allegiance
Approval of Agenda
8. Discussion regarding annexation of properties located south of the City and north of Mulholland Highway, and for which annexation interest has been expressed by the property owners.
11. Discussion regarding a visit from the Anqing Huangmei Opera Troupe.
ANNOUNCEMENTS/INTRODUCTIONS
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS - PUBLIC COMMENT
CONSENT ITEMS
1. Approval of meeting minutes from September 22, 2010.
2. Approval of expenditure of Supplemental Law Enforcement Services Fund for fiscal year 2010/2011.
3. Adoption of Resolution No. 2010-1265, approving the acquisition of One Los Angeles County tax-defaulted property in Old Topanga in the amount of $5,530 plus administration costs (Assessor Parcel Number 2072-025-002).
4. Authorization to approve a contract change order to fund the existing contract and extra work for ValleyCrest Landscape Maintenance for the landscape maintenance of public works street medians, certain sidewalks and parkway areas.
5. Recommendation to authorize the Mayor to sign and execute the quitclaim of easement deeds to The Oaks of Calabasas Homeowners Association for future operation, maintenance, repair and improvement to Storm Drain Line D of M.T.D. 1712, within Tract 35596.
6. Recommendation to approve the agreement with 26705 Malibu Hills Road, LLC, releasing the performance security grading bond for the construction of a 60 unit senior condominium at 26705 Malibu Hills Road.
7. Update on Measure "R" Funding and Projects, including the Lost Hills Overpass.
9. Discussion regarding establishing a loan program for assistance for septic system and building code violations repair.
10. Adoption of Resolution No. 2010-1264, consenting to inclusion of the City of Calabasas within the incorporated area of the Los Angeles County Energy Program to finance distributed generation renewable energy sources and energy and water efficiency improvements, approving the report setting forth the parameters of the referenced program and certain matters in connection therewith.
11. Discussion regarding a visit from the Anqing Huangmei Opera Troupe.
12. Check Register for the period of September 15, 2010 to September 29, 2010.
TASK FORCE REPORTS
CITY MANAGER’S REPORT
FUTURE AGENDA ITEMS
ADJOURN
Respectfully submitted:
Gwen Peirce
Assistant City Clerk
